name: forearm-flexors-lacrosse-balls
instructions:
1. In a half kneeling position, place the lacrosse ball directly underneath the outside portion of your forearm and apply your free hand to the forearm to regulate pressure.
2. Slowly roll up and down the length of the forearm for 20-30 seconds.
3. Repeat on the other side.
